capabilities: Generate content with AI from anywhere in the vault
Run AI actions on selected text
Trigger AI actions via keyboard shortcuts and quick-action buttons
Correct grammar, translate, generate diagrams, and adjust code
Configure and test an API key in settings
extras: Usage requires a paid API subscription; the README links setup and shortcut tutorial videos rather than explaining all features in text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance for generating content or transforming selected text without leaving the editor.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses an API called 'Obsidian AI API.'

requires.name: Subscription to the Obsidian AI API

summary: AI assistant that generates Markdown content and applies AI actions to selected text through shortcuts and quick-action buttons.
